A '''device''' built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denab/Legends|Denab]], and was malfunctioning during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]; it began generating new species of [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and animals.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Survival of the Strangest}}</ref>
